install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME" && curl -fsSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.44.0-stable.tar.xz" -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz -C "$HOME" && rm -f /tmp/flutter.tar.xz; fi; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter pub get && npm --prefix functions ci
